explication: pnpm is a fast, disk-efficient Node.js package manager; the README also describes workspace support and runtime version management. The principal workflow is a user command entering the CLI, selecting workspace projects, resolving dependencies, then materializing an install into the project and shared store. The tree documents additional command families for package mutations, scripts, publishing, security, and runtime management. Several implementation details are unsampled, so edges describe only the documented workflow and visible orchestration; this is not a complete call graph.
